sheets.title: LIGHTING LOWER LEVEL PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Single-story retail grocery floor plan showing full new LED lighting layout. Rows of suspended Trilux linear LED fixtures (triangular symbols) covering the sales floor, aligned along aisle runs. Spot/track lighting symbols visible in perimeter and end-cap areas (Oktalite EL370 spotlights). Note (1): Use same lighting circuits for new retrofit fixtures — implies overlay on existing circuit infrastructure. Note (2): Refer to lighting calculations for spotlight angles. Note (3): Refer to lighting fixture schedule on E-501. Scale 3/32" = 1'-0". BFA project number 20-008. No scale bar showing overall dimensions but footprint is consistent with a mid-size grocery store (~20,000–30,000 SF estimate from plan proportion at stated scale — not confirmed by text source). Back-of-house areas (break room, storage, office) shown in lower-right but no fixtures indicated there.

sheets.title: LIGHTING FIXTURE SCHEDULE
sheets.reading_notes: Lighting fixture schedule with 5 fixture types. F1A: 76500T LED5500, 120V, 50W, suspended, trunk-mount compatible; F1C: 76500T LED2200, 120V, 20W, suspended, trunk-mount compatible; F2A: EL370 LOBU G2 LED4000, 120V, 30W, suspended, trunk-mount compatible; F10C: 07650B/35 Metal US, N/A wattage (trunk/accessory); F10D: 07650B/L370 Metal US, N/A wattage (trunk/accessory). Product data cut sheets for TRILUX E-Line LED (F1A diffuse optic), E-Line F1C (diffuse optic short), TRILUX E-Line LED Spotlights F2A & F2B, and E-Line blanking covers/trunking accessories shown. All fixtures are TRILUX/Oktalite brand (Trillux US distribution). Consistent with both stores — same schedule appears on Store #1105 E-501.

sheets.title: LIGHTING LOWER LEVEL PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Virtually identical layout to Store #1057 E-101. Same single-story grocery retail footprint and fixture layout. Additional note (4) specific to Store #1105: 'LIGHTING ON AISLES #5 & #6 HAS ALREADY BEEN INSTALLED BY ANOTHER VENDOR. VERIFY LIGHTING FIXTURES IF THEY ARE MOUNTED AT 11' 6" AFF.' This indicates partial prior work at Store #1105 by a different contractor before BFA's involvement, and BFA's drawings accommodate this condition. General notes (1–3) are identical to Store #1057.

sheets.title: LIGHTING FIXTURE SCHEDULE
sheets.reading_notes: Identical fixture schedule to Store #1057 E-501 — same five fixture types and product data sheets. Confirms the program-level standardized fixture specification across both Lidl stores.

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: Both values retained in reading notes; likely 40W = LED driver input per IES file, 50W = circuit design wattage or rated system wattage — minor catalog/spec variance
conflict_flags.rationale: Small magnitude discrepancy (40W vs 50W); could reflect different measurement basis (driver input vs. system wattage including ballast/driver losses or different model suffix). No bearing on project narrative but worth flagging.

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: DWM, Inc. as client_name; Lidl as owner_name
conflict_flags.rationale: DWM is the contracting party issuing the RFQ to BFA. Lidl is the facility owner/end client. This is a three-tier relationship: Lidl (owner) → DWM, Inc. (facility management/retrofit contractor) → BFA (subconsultant for CAD/engineering services).
